prompt: Wireframe an IONOS server management dashboard. At the top, show 4 stat cards (active servers, monthly traffic, uptime percentage, open tickets). Below that, a table-like server list with 3 rows. Add staggered entrance animations so the stat cards fade in one by one.

assertions.text: ThemeProvider with brand='ionos' wraps the output
Four stat card elements are present covering active servers, traffic, uptime, and tickets
CSS @keyframes or animation property is used for entrance animations
Each stat card has a different animation-delay value to create the stagger effect
Colors reference CSS custom properties rather than hard-coded hex values
Server list section contains at least 3 rows/items
Animation durations are in the 200-600ms range (not instant or excessively long)
